title: 提名你心中的 2026 社区奖行业英雄
content:
Nominate your work heroes in our 2026 community awards – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
This year we’re throwing open our end-of-year awards to you, the bold and wise mobilegamer.biz reader.
Important: these awards celebrate individuals, not companies.
We want to reward the people in this business really making things happen: getting deals done, forging partnerships and making the mobile games business a better place to work.
Have a think and fill in the form below.
You’ll need to provide a real email address so that your vote counts
. While you’re there, you also have the option to sign up to our weekly newsletter.
Keep an eye on mobilegamer.biz in the next few weeks to find out who the finalists are, and then you can vote for them, too.
The winners will be announced just before the Christmas break, and will get a real, actual award.
Having trouble with the form? Have other feedback? Email
neil@mobilegamer.biz
.
